Name: Aspect of Lussuria
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
Lussuria generally sees no need to incarnate beyond the divine curtain, and has been known to possess mortals who follow her and uses them as her mouthpiece instead. Those who are both permitted to act as her avatar and possess the mental fortitude required to survive the psychic trauma involved are given the title of Delicate Panderess (or Panderer, though the role is rarely assigned to men), and otherwise are the leaders of the brothels, religious circles, and minor associations connected to Lussuria. To be possessed by Lussuria is seen as her ultimate act of adoration.

In the Material Plane, Lussuria is primarily interested in finding servants and devotees who are of a high enough caliber to become her eternal pets. The end goal of any of her devotees is to gather wealth and tributes for her, to become one of the “pets” she claims in her divine realm and live eternally as part of her divine harem, or to earn the title of Delicate Panderess and gain the highest level of influence among her followers.

Lussuria likes to collect individuals who have high status among mankind so that she can toy with the affairs of others through them. Her Celestial Brothel is constantly trying to earn favor with those in positions of power and bring them into their thrall. Lussuria is no stranger to making contracts with such people in the same way a devil would, promising them good health, immortality in her realm, or success in return for servitude or favors.

traits.name: Awakening Desires (Mythic Awakening)
traits.description: If Lussuria is reduced to 0 hit points or is killed outright, her current hit point total resets to 150, and she ends any magical effects targeting her that she wishes to escape. She then teleports to an unoccupied space within 60 feet, regains her Legendary Reactions, and can use her Mythic Actions for 1 hour. A party that defeats her after using her Awakening Desires is awarded an additional 22,000 XP (44,000 XP total).

traits.name: Grace Before Brutality
traits.description: Lussuria can use her Dexterity in place of her Strength any time it would be required, including in place of Strength saving throws, for Strength-based ability and skill checks, and for weapon attacks and damage.

traits.name: Lady of Conquering Dynamics
traits.description: When Lussuria uses any feature to charm a creature that would be immune to the effect, they are instead stunned for the duration they would have been charmed as their mind is filled with a vexing assault of contradictory desires that cripple their ability to process information. At the end of each of the creature’s turns they make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Lussuria makes two Rosevine Glaive attacks, then uses her Bombastic Charm, Sensuous Drain, or casts a spell using Innate Spellcasting with a casting time of 1 action.

actions.name: Rosevine Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d10 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Bombastic Charm
actions.description: One creature Lussuria can see within 60 feet of her must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be magically charmed for 1 minute. The charmed target is affected as though by the effects of the dominate monster spell during that time. The target makes saving throws when taking damage as described. If they remain charmed for 1 minute, they become cursed permanently, during which time they remain charmed this way without making saving throws and Lussuria doesn’t need to concentrate on the effect. If a spell that removes curses is cast to remedy this curse, its caster must make a DC 20 spellcasting ability check. On a failure, the curse remains. A 7th-level or higher spell bypasses this check. Lussuria can only charm one creature at a time using this effect, not including those permanently cursed by it.

actions.name: Sensuous Drain
actions.description:
Lussuria makes intimate physical contact with one creature she has stunned or charmed, who must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure their life force is drained, causing them to take 33 (5d12) psychic damage, or half as much on a successful one. Lussuria gains temporary hit points equal to the damage she deals, and the target’s maximum hit points are reduced by half the damage they take. This reduction is permanent unless cured by a spell or effect.

The damage caused by this effect does not trigger additional saving throws to end the charmed or stunned conditions on other targets.

bonus_actions.name: Mythic Action: Fey Dictation
bonus_actions.description: Lussuria extends her influence to one creature she can see within 30 feet, who must succeed a DC 20 Charisma saving throw. If the creature is immune to being charmed they automatically succeed this save. On a failure, they must use their reaction to move up to half their movement speed toward a creature Lussuria decides, and makes a weapon attack against them.

reactions.name: Joint Burden
reactions.description: When Lussuria takes damage from an attack or effect she can see, she can transfer half of the damage she would take to a creature within 30 feet of her who is either willing to accept this damage, or is charmed by her.

On a hit Lussuria can choose one of the following: to deal damage as usual, or to teleport the creature to another unoccupied space within 60 feet of Lussuria. When teleported the creature appears standing on the ground.

options.name: Bombastic Charm (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Lussuria uses her Bombastic Charm on one creature within 30 feet of her.

options.name: Veil of No Approach (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Until the start of her next turn, Lussuria creates a shroud of psychic influence - a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on her. Any creature that attempts to move toward Lussuria or attack her while inside the radius must succeed a DC 20 Charisma saving throw, or be unable to make attacks against her or move anywhere except out of the sphere. On a success they become immune to this instance of this effect.

**ASPECT OF LUSSURIA**
*Medium fey, chaotic neutral*
**Armor Class** 20 (natural armor)

**Speed** 30 ft., fly (hover) 60 ft., teleport 30 ft.
**Quality Traits** Deific, magic resist
**STR** 16 (+3) | **DEX** 20 (+5) | **CON** 18 (+4) | **INT** 13 (+1) | **WIS** 18 (+4) | **CHA** 23 (+6)
**Saving Throws** Int +8, Wis +10, Cha +12
**Skills** Insight +12, Nature +7, Perception +10, Persuasion +12
**Immunities** poison; B/S/P (magical)
**Condition Immunities** charmed, exhaustion, poisoned

• ***1/Day each:*** artemina’s hunting bow, conjure bestial echo, conquering winds, hallucinatory terrain, scrying
• ***2/Day each:*** biting curse, heal, major illusion
• ***3/Day each:*** entangle, shield of summer

All of Lussuria’s spells are cast as if at 4th level, unless their base level is higher.
